parole.testo: Inherited from Ottoman Turkish طولغه (tolga), variant of طوغلغه (toğulga, “helmet”), from a Mongolic source, ultimately from Proto-Mongolic *dugulga (“helmet”). Cognates Cognate with Azerbaijani dəbilqə, Kazakh дулыға (duwlığa), Kumyk давулгъа (dawulğa), Kyrgyz туулга (tuulga), Southern Altai туулга
